changes.before: There is no form on this page. Staff writing is not accepted or stored.
changes.after: There is no form on this page. This site neither accepts nor stores staff-submitted material. If you need to share information, use another communication channel approved by your team or supervisor. This policy limits the risk of collecting unintended or sensitive content through this interface.
changes.reason: Clarified why staff writing is not accepted or stored and explained the practical consequence. Stated the intended limitation and pointed users toward an appropriate alternative process, connecting the policy to maintaining information security and compliance. Removed redundant phrasing and added specificity on next steps.

findings.finding: The revised text introduces new policy justification and advice not supported by the source. The original source states only: 'There is no form on this page. Staff writing is not accepted or stored.' The proposed version adds: 'This site neither accepts nor stores staff-submitted material. If you need to share information, use another communication channel approved by your team or supervisor. This policy limits the risk of collecting unintended or sensitive content through this interface.' There is no source evidence for the explanation of policy intent (information security and compliance) or the instruction to use other channels. These additions change the meaning and go beyond what the official text provides. Preserve the original scope and do not invent expanded guidance or policy rationale where not present in the source.
